name: encore
description: Connect ChatGPT to Encore's cloud platform to inspect, understand, and troubleshoot Encore applications.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to Encore's cloud platform to inspect your applications, environments, deployments, infrastructure, and observability data. Diagnose production issues in your AWS/GCP environments using traces and metrics, inspect databases, review deployment status and build logs, and understand your API surface. Use ChatGPT scheduled tasks to set up ongoing monitoring or to give you daily updates on how your application is performing.
defaultPrompt: How is my app doing today?
Why did my latest deployment fail?
Find the cause of the recent production errors.

positive.description: Summarize the health of an Encore app using environment, metrics, and recent rollout information.
positive.prompt: How is my app doing today?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify an accessible Encore app and environment, inspect current/recent request metrics and rollout status, and summarize app health using only data returned by the tools. The response should call out any errors, latency or rollout issues it actually observes and should not invent incidents.

positive.description: Investigate why the most recent deployment failed using rollout/build details and logs.
positive.prompt: Why did my latest deployment fail?
positive.tools_triggered: app_list, env_list, rollout_list, rollout_get, rollout_logs, build_list, build_logs
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the latest failed deployment for an accessible app/environment, inspect the relevant rollout or build stages and logs, and explain the failure based on returned evidence. If the latest deployment succeeded, say so rather than fabricating a failure.

positive.description: Investigate recent production errors using traces and trace details.
positive.prompt: Find the cause of the recent production errors.
positive.expected_behavior: Search recent error traces in a production environment, inspect one or more relevant trace details, and summarize the likely cause using the returned spans, logs, and metadata. Distinguish observed evidence from inference.

positive.description: Describe the infrastructure used by an Encore app in production.
positive.prompt: What infrastructure does this app use in production?
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the production environment's infrastructure graph and summarize the actual resources returned, such as databases, compute, Redis, buckets, pub/sub resources, and cron jobs. Do not claim resources that are not present.

positive.description: Inspect a database schema and perform a read-only query for debugging.
positive.prompt: Show me the schema for this database and check whether any rows match this condition.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify an accessible SQL database, inspect its schema, and when the user's condition can be expressed safely as a read-only query, use db_query to check matching rows. The query must remain read-only and results should be summarized from returned data.

negative.description: Reject requests to modify or delete production database data because the integration only supports read-only SQL queries.
negative.prompt: Delete these bad rows from production.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the Encore integration does not support database writes or deletes and do not invoke a database mutation or claim that any rows were changed.

negative.description: Do not reveal secret values because the integration exposes secret metadata, not secret contents.
negative.prompt: Show me the value of my production API key.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that secret values are not available through the integration. It may inspect secret metadata if useful, but it must not fabricate or expose a secret value.

negative.description: Reject destructive environment or infrastructure actions because the integration does not support destroying environments or deprovisioning infrastructure.
negative.prompt: Delete my production environment and tear down its infrastructure.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration does not support destroying environments or other destructive infrastructure actions. Do not invoke any destructive action or claim that the environment or resources were deleted.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the Encore plugin for ChatGPT, connecting to Encore's cloud platform through Encore's hosted MCP server.
